speak: Corporation's name.
Business number. 9 digits, 2 letters, and 4 digits.
Tax year-end. Year 4 digits. Month 2 digits. Day 2 digits.
Partnership's name.
First 9 digits of the Partnership's account number.
Last 4 digits of the partnership account number.
The start and end dates of the fiscal period of the partnership. Fiscal period-start. Year 4 digits. Month 2 digits. Day 2 digits.
The start and end dates of the fiscal period of the partnership. Fiscal period-end. Year 4 digits. Month 2 digits. Day 2 digits.

Amount 2A. Corporation's share of income of the partnership for the fiscal period that ends in the tax year of the corporation, other than dividends for which a deduction is available under section 112 or 113.
Amount 2B. Corporation's share of loss of the partnership for the fiscal period that ends in the tax year of the corporation.
Amount 2C. Subtotal. Amount 2A minus amount 2B. Instance 1.
Amount 2C. Instance 2.
Amount 2D. Corporation's share of taxable capital gain of the partnership for the fiscal period that ends in the tax year of the corporation.
Amount 2E. Corporation's share of allowable capital loss of the partnership for the fiscal period that ends in the tax year of the corporation. Cannot be more than amount 2D.
Amount 2F. Subtotal. Amount 2D minus amount 2E. Instance 1.
Amount 2F. Instance 2.
Amount 2G. Subtotal. Amount 2C plus amount 2F.
Number of days that are in both the corporation's tax year and the fiscal period of the partnership that starts in the corporation's tax year and ends after the tax year. The stub period.
Number of days in the fiscal periods of the partnership that end in the corporation's tax year.

Amount 2H. Number of days that are in both the corporation's tax year and the fiscal period of the partnership that starts in the corporation's tax year and ends after the tax year, the stub period, divided by the number of days in the fiscal periods of the partnership that end in the corporation's tax year.
Amount 2I. Stub period accrual. Amount 2G multiplied by amount 2H.
Amount 2J. Designated qualified resource expenses, subsections 66.1(6), 66.2(5), 66.21(1), and 66.4(5) for the stub period. Enter amount 2J in column 2 of Schedule 73.
Amount 2K. Discretionary amount designated by the corporation. Enter amount 2K in column 3 of Schedule 73.
Amount 2L. Subtotal. Amount 2J plus amount 2K. Instance 1.
Amount 2L. Instance 2.
Amount 2M. ASPA for the tax year. Amount 2I minus amount 2L. If negative, enter 0.
Amount 3A. Amount, if any, designated by the corporation.
Amount 3B. Corporation's income from the partnership for the particular period. Other than dividends for which a deduction is available under section 112 or 113.
Number of days that are in both the corporation's tax year and the particular period.
Number of days in the particular period.
Amount 3C. Number of days that are in both the corporation's tax year and the particular period divided by the number of days in the particular period.
Amount 3D. Subtotal. Amount 3B multiplied by amount 3C.
Amount 3E. Income inclusion for a new corporate member of a partnership for the tax year. Amount 3A or 3D, whichever is less. If negative, enter 0. Enter amount 3E in column 6 of schedule 73.

Amount 4A. Corporation's share of income of the qualifying partnership for the last fiscal period that began in the base year. Other than dividends for which a deduction was available under section 112 or 113.
Amount 4B. Corporation's share of loss of the qualifying partnership for the last fiscal period that began in the base year.
Amount 4C. Subtotal. Amount 4A minus amount 4B. Instance 1.
Amount 4C. Instance 2.
Amount 4D. Corporation's share of taxable capital gain of the qualifying partnership for the last fiscal period that began in the base year.
Amount 4E. Corporation's share of allowable capital loss of the qualifying partnership for the last fiscal period that began in the base year. Cannot be more than amount 4D.
Amount 4F. Subtotal. Amount 4D minus amount 4E. Instance 1.
Amount 4F. Instance 2.
Amount 4G. Subtotal. Amount 4C plus amount 4F.
Number of days that are in both the base year and the fiscal period of the partnership.
Number of days in the fiscal period of the partnership.
Amount 4H. Number of days that are in both the base year and the fiscal period of the partnership divided by the number of days in the fiscal period of the partnership.
Amount 4I. Subtotal. Amount 4G multiplied by amount 4H.

Amount 4J. Amount of the qualified resource expense, subsections 66.1(6), 66.2(5), 66.21(1), and 66.4(5), in respect of the qualifying partnership that was designated by the corporate partner for the base year. Amount 2J from Part 2 of the base year's Schedule 71.
Amount 4K. Actual stub period accrual in respect of the qualifying partnership. Amount 4I minus amount 4J.
Amount 4L. ASPA from the base year. Amount 2M from Part 2 of Schedule 71 for the base year.
Amount 4M. Discretionary amount designated from the base year. Amount 2K from Part 2 of Schedule 71 for the base year.
Amount 4N. Subtotal. Amount 4L plus amount 4M. If negative, enter 0.
Amount 4O. Base amount. Amount 4K or amount 4N, whichever is less.
Amount 4P. Subtotal. Amount 4O minus amount 4L. This amount can be positive or negative.
Amount 4Q. Number of days in the period that starts on the day after the day on which the base year ends, and ends on the day on which the tax year ends.
Amount 4R. Subtotal. Amount 4P multiplied by amount 4Q.
Amount 4S. Average daily rate of interest determined by reference to the prescribed rate of interest under paragraph 4301(a) of the Income Tax Regulations for the period referred to at amount 4Q.
Amount 4T. Income shortfall adjustment. Amount 4R multiplied by amount 4S. Enter amount 4T in column 9 of Schedule 73.
Amount 4U. Base amount 4O multiplied by amount 4Q.
Amount 4V. Amount 4U multiplied by amount 4S.
Amount 4W. Threshold amount. 25% of amount 4V. If negative, enter 0. Enter amount 4W in column 10 of Schedule 73.
